label: Why us
heading: Good mid-size apartments are under-owned, under-managed and hard for investors to reach.
lede: We built JR Capital to close four gaps we see every day in Ohio real estate.

gaps.gap_title: The middle of the market is overlooked
gaps.gap_body: Mid-size apartment communities are too large for most local owners and too small for institutional funds. Many are held for decades and run below their potential.
gaps.answer_title: We specialize in exactly this size
gaps.answer_body: It is the segment where a focused, hands-on operator has the biggest advantage and the least competition.

gaps.gap_body: Sponsors who rely on outside contractors and fee managers lose control of cost, schedule and accountability.
gaps.answer_title: We build and manage it ourselves
gaps.answer_body: Our own crews price and complete the work, and our affiliated manager runs the property, so the business plan stays on track.

gaps.gap_body: Many Ohio apartment communities need new interiors, systems and better management, while working households need quality rentals they can afford.
gaps.answer_title: We renovate to a durable standard
gaps.answer_body: Upgraded homes and responsive management attract and keep good residents, which supports steady income for investors.

gaps.gap_body: Busy professionals want real estate in their portfolio but don’t have the deal flow, local team or hours to buy and run apartments.
gaps.answer_body: Investors own a share of professionally run communities and receive quarterly reporting, distributions and K-1s without managing anything.
